verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support for this story: keyboard shortcuts exist in the editor (`[[` for linking, `cmd j` for the AI palette), users describe Reflect as fast and easy to use, and users can upload files and images into notes. None of the formatting elements the story names are documented. Missing for 10: headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, documented media embedding, and a comprehensive keyboard-shortcut or markdown-formatting reference.
